findings.title: ML / Quantitative: $30,000 capital, zero positions
findings.observation: Pod 'ML / Quantitative' has a $30,000 budget and currently holds $30,000 with zero open positions.
findings.why_wrong: CRO at HIGH may justify caution, but idle capital earns zero return and represents a failure to execute on the pod's mandate.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish the cause, then act: (1) run `python3 ml_pipeline.py` — if it produces picks, this was a pipeline stall, not a policy choice; (2) if it produces nothing and CRO isn't blocking, lower the pod's conviction threshold or widen its watchlist; (3) if the pod is intentionally flat, write the reason and a concrete re-deploy trigger into pod_allocations.json so this stops re-firing.

findings.title: CRO=HIGH for 30 cycles (120 days) — board must vote
findings.observation: The CRO has been at HIGH for 30 consecutive pipeline cycles (~120 days). During this time, all new buy orders have been blocked. The board last met 0 days ago.
findings.why_wrong: An extended buy block is a major business decision. It should require ongoing board ratification — not just persist automatically. It penalizes research agents for low approved-picks even when they're working correctly.
findings.suggestion: Board should formally vote: (1) Is HIGH still warranted? (2) If yes, what specific condition triggers a downgrade? (3) If no, step down to ELEVATED with 25% cash floor instead of 40%.

findings.title: 3 Chairman action item(s) unresolved for >3 days
findings.observation: Items: '?', 'ML v3/v4/v5 fail every nightly run — pyarrow never', 'logic_team noon run missed when Mac sleeps — not i'
findings.why_wrong: Items flagged for Chairman action should be resolved promptly. Stale items indicate a process gap.
findings.suggestion: Review data/chairman_action_required.json and action or dismiss each item.

findings.title: CRO at HIGH for 120+ days — firm has no buy strategy
findings.observation: The CRO has blocked all buys for 30 cycles (~120 days). The firm currently holds 12 position(s) and is generating picks it cannot deploy. This is not a risk posture — it is a strategy vacuum.
findings.why_wrong: A firm that can never buy is not an investment firm. Extended buy blocks that persist without board review indicate the risk framework has captured the governance framework.
findings.suggestion: Board must vote: either (1) accept the current posture with an explicit end condition, or (2) define specific criteria to step down CRO level. A perpetual HIGH with no exit criteria is not governance.

findings.title: 7 open positions have no review recommendation
findings.observation: state.json shows 7 position(s) that don't appear in review_recommendations.json: ['GS', 'LLY', 'NEE', 'AMAT', 'KO']. These positions are unmonitored — no stop-loss or exit signal.
findings.why_wrong: The review agent can only manage positions it knows about. Ghost positions accumulate losses silently with no exit trigger.
findings.suggestion: Reconcile: run review_agent.py manually, or check if positions were opened outside the normal pipeline flow.

findings.title: 4 expected agent(s) silent on firm channel >7 days
findings.observation: These agents have not posted to the firm channel in 7+ days: Canary Agent, Chief of Staff, IRM Director, Operations Director. Either they're not running or their output isn't reaching the channel.
findings.why_wrong: Silent agents are invisible agents. If an agent stops communicating, nobody knows whether it's healthy or broken.
findings.suggestion: Check crontab and most recent logs for each silent agent.

findings.title: CIT backlog has 500 open items — proposals not being actioned
findings.observation: data/cit_backlog.json holds 500 entries, 500 open. A backlog this deep means the CIT is generating proposals far faster than the boards act on them — volume without throughput.
findings.why_wrong: A perpetually-growing backlog is the 'useless solutions' failure mode: effort is spent producing proposals nobody implements. Either the proposals lack value or the action path is broken.
findings.suggestion: Triage: sample 20 open BUG_FIX items — if most are low-value/duplicate, raise the CIT confidence/precision gate. If they're valuable, the board action path is the bottleneck — route more to the deputy board for auto-implement. The write site now caps the file at 500.

findings.title: ML / Quantitative: $30,000 capital, zero positions
findings.observation: Pod 'ML / Quantitative' has a $30,000 budget and currently holds $30,000 with zero open positions.
findings.why_wrong: CRO at HIGH may justify caution, but idle capital earns zero return and represents a failure to execute on the pod's mandate.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish the cause, then act: (1) run `python3 ml_pipeline.py` — if it produces picks, this was a pipeline stall, not a policy choice; (2) if it produces nothing and CRO isn't blocking, lower the pod's conviction threshold or widen its watchlist; (3) if the pod is intentionally flat, write the reason and a concrete re-deploy trigger into pod_allocations.json so this stops re-firing.

findings.title: CRO=HIGH for 37 cycles (148 days) — board must vote
findings.observation: The CRO has been at HIGH for 37 consecutive pipeline cycles (~148 days). During this time, all new buy orders have been blocked. The board last met 0 days ago.
findings.why_wrong: An extended buy block is a major business decision. It should require ongoing board ratification — not just persist automatically. It penalizes research agents for low approved-picks even when they're working correctly.
findings.suggestion: Board should formally vote: (1) Is HIGH still warranted? (2) If yes, what specific condition triggers a downgrade? (3) If no, step down to ELEVATED with 25% cash floor instead of 40%.

findings.title: 3 Chairman action item(s) unresolved for >3 days
findings.observation: Items: '?', 'ML v3/v4/v5 fail every nightly run — pyarrow never', 'logic_team noon run missed when Mac sleeps — not i'
findings.why_wrong: Items flagged for Chairman action should be resolved promptly. Stale items indicate a process gap.
findings.suggestion: Review data/chairman_action_required.json and action or dismiss each item.

findings.title: CRO at HIGH for 148+ days — firm has no buy strategy
findings.observation: The CRO has blocked all buys for 37 cycles (~148 days). The firm currently holds 12 position(s) and is generating picks it cannot deploy. This is not a risk posture — it is a strategy vacuum.
findings.why_wrong: A firm that can never buy is not an investment firm. Extended buy blocks that persist without board review indicate the risk framework has captured the governance framework.
findings.suggestion: Board must vote: either (1) accept the current posture with an explicit end condition, or (2) define specific criteria to step down CRO level. A perpetual HIGH with no exit criteria is not governance.

findings.title: 7 open positions have no review recommendation

findings.why_wrong: The review agent can only manage positions it knows about. Ghost positions accumulate losses silently with no exit trigger.
findings.suggestion: Reconcile: run review_agent.py manually, or check if positions were opened outside the normal pipeline flow.
